text: The PCRIC Coral Reef Parametric Insurance Policy is a pioneering initiative in Fiji designed to provide rapid financial support for coral reef restoration and community livelihoods following tropical cyclones. Administered by the Pacific Catastrophe Risk Insurance Company for the Vatuvara Foundation, this policy offers up to US$450,000 in coverage. It utilizes parametric triggers based on cyclone characteristics to ensure swift payouts, enabling timely reef recovery and community assistance in the Northern Lau group of islands.
